why: Several figures are in none of the three listed sources (all three were checked): 72 ambulances; the Al-Wasta, Al-Ayyat and Atfih hospitals; the 2002 fire toll (more than 360, some figures above 370); Sohag 2021 (at least 20 dead, 199 injured, eight staff detained); Ramses 2019 (at least 22 dead); and 'severe rail accidents rose from 289 in 2020 to 752 in 2024', which is credited only to 'official statistics cited in the coverage'. The train numbers 134 and 2010 and the Tahya Misr service are also not in the sources fetched. The prosecution, toll (7 dead, 125 injured, 132/71/43/11) and parliament facts do match.
